signal_definitions.abstract_system: An abstract architecture or system needs a spatial or structural explanation.
signal_definitions.action_cta: The approved meaning ends with one explicit next action.
signal_definitions.cause_effect: The audience must see a causal relationship rather than decoration.
signal_definitions.chapter_change: The approved narrative enters a new topic or chapter.
signal_definitions.code_or_ui_detail: Small source text, code, controls, or interface detail must remain readable.
signal_definitions.comparison_contrast: Two approved alternatives need one clear visual difference.
signal_definitions.concept_icon: A compact, approved concept can be represented by a simple vector icon.
signal_definitions.definition_reveal: A term and its exact approved explanation should be revealed together.
signal_definitions.diagram_relationship: The relationship between diagram nodes or labels carries meaning.
signal_definitions.digital_error: A digital failure or corrupted-state metaphor is explicitly part of the meaning.
signal_definitions.emotional_payoff: A source-backed emotional or rhetorical landing deserves one accent.
signal_definitions.formal_logic: Formal states, equations, graphs, or logic must be explained precisely.
signal_definitions.freeze_frame_payoff: One source frame is itself the approved evidence or punchline.
signal_definitions.geometry_match: Adjacent approved images share meaningful geometry or movement.
signal_definitions.hide_weak_cut: The only requested purpose is hiding an editorially weak cut; creative routing must stop.
signal_definitions.identity_context: The viewer needs a restrained identity or role label.
signal_definitions.keyword_emphasis: One exact approved word or short phrase is the semantic landing.
signal_definitions.music_rhythm: Approved music rhythm may drive accents without overriding speech meaning.
signal_definitions.ordered_steps: Two to five approved steps must be understood in order.
signal_definitions.screen_target: A specific source-screen control, label, or region is being discussed.
signal_definitions.shot_local_reframe: A deliberate source-backed reframe must enter, hold, and reset within one continuous shot.
signal_definitions.source_quote: A verbatim source-backed quotation is the visual focus.
signal_definitions.spatial_depth: Foreground/background depth itself supports the approved explanation.
signal_definitions.speaker_foreground_layering: An approved short slot calls for graphics behind an isolated presenter.
signal_definitions.statistic_payoff: One source-backed number is the payoff.
signal_definitions.time_place_change: The source truthfully changes time or place.
signal_definitions.title_scope: A title states the approved promise or chapter scope.
signal_definitions.transition_motivated: A transition is semantically motivated and not merely decorative.
signal_definitions.transformation_relationship: One approved concept becomes another and the transformation is meaningful.

tools.label: SPRUT Motion Cards
tools.license: Local project code using approved open-source dependencies
responsibilities: Readable titles, definitions, comparisons, processes, quotations, chapters, and CTAs
Deterministic fallback when a more expressive engine is unavailable
avoid: Do not turn every sentence into a card
Do not replace source evidence with an editorial summary

effects.label: Readable promise/title card
effects.recipe: Render the approved title with one orange hierarchy accent and a readable hold; preserve source geometry.

effects.label: Term plus exact definition
effects.recipe: Reveal one approved term, then its exact explanation; hold the complete state for at least one second.

effects.label: Two-way comparison
effects.recipe: Show both approved alternatives simultaneously and use orange on only the active difference.

effects.label: Ordered process card
effects.recipe: Reveal one approved step at a time and leave the complete process readable before exit.

effects.label: Source-backed quotation
effects.recipe: Display only the approved source-backed quotation with a restrained source label when approved.

effects.label: Branded chapter card
effects.recipe: Use a clean near-black full-frame bridge with white chapter text and one orange progress action.

effects.label: Single-action CTA
effects.recipe: Show one approved next action; never invent a destination, offer, or claim.

tools.label: HyperFrames + GSAP Motion Kit
tools.license: HyperFrames Apache-2.0; GSAP Standard no-charge package license
responsibilities: Kinetic typography, SVG drawing and morphing, chapter bridges, and deterministic web motion
avoid: Do not use remote assets, publish, cloud, TTS, music, avatar, or generative integrations
Do not animate independent concepts simultaneously

effects.label: Kinetic approved keyword
effects.recipe: Use SplitText for one approved phrase, cubic easing, a readable hold, and no continuous word-by-word transcription.

effects.label: Restrained identity lower third
effects.recipe: Show only the approved name/role context in a compact lower third, then remove it before it competes with the explanation.

effects.label: Source-backed statistic hit
effects.recipe: Land one approved number on its spoken payoff word; keep units and qualifier visible.

effects.label: Progressive SVG relationship draw
effects.recipe: Keep original diagram lines white and use DrawSVG with orange only for the active route or node.

effects.label: Meaningful SVG transformation
effects.recipe: Morph one approved concept shape into the next; show both labelled states and preserve the causal meaning.

effects.label: Premium chapter bridge
effects.recipe: Build one branded chapter entrance with a long readable hold; place it adjacent to a verified hard cut.

effects.label: Approved full-frame cover wipe
effects.recipe: Use the audited cover-wipe asset only over a hard cut and pass transition asset QA plus N-1/N/N+1 inspection.

effects.label: Approved text behind presenter
effects.recipe: Use a short Apple Vision foreground layer, keep the presenter geometry, and test matte edges on black, white, and orange.

tools.label: Rough Notation annotations
responsibilities: Hand-drawn circles, underlines, brackets, and highlights attached to source-screen information
avoid: Do not cover labels or use multiple simultaneous annotations

effects.label: Tracked hand-drawn screen annotation
effects.recipe: Attach one white/orange annotation to the approved ROI and keep the underlying source label unobscured.

tools.label: Manim Community
responsibilities: Formal graphs, state machines, equations, and technical relationships
avoid: Do not use for decorative text motion or simple callouts

effects.label: Formal technical diagram
effects.recipe: Animate one formal relationship at a time, retain labels, and hold the completed graph for comprehension.

tools.label: Shot-aware virtual camera
responsibilities: Stable punch-ins, screen reframes, and subpixel camera motion reset at every source cut
avoid: Do not follow face micro-motion or crop important screen information

effects.label: Stable semantic punch zoom
effects.recipe: Reset at the shot boundary, use a dead zone and acceleration cap, then ease to a visibly intentional crop without jitter.

effects.label: Protected screen reframe
effects.recipe: Show context first, ease to the protected ROI, keep every label legible, then return to context when relationships matter.

tools.label: PixiJS + curated filters
responsibilities: Short GPU-accelerated particles, shockwaves, glow, displacement, and texture accents
avoid: Do not use GPU effects as a full-program color grade
Do not distort readable source screens

effects.label: Short semantic shockwave
effects.recipe: Land one brief shockwave on the payoff and return immediately to a clean stable frame.

effects.label: Meaning-driven signal particles
effects.recipe: Use a small number of particles to show approved flow or transfer; particles must not become ambient decoration.

tools.label: Lottie-web
tools.license: MIT runtime; each animation asset requires its own rights record
responsibilities: Compact vector icons, micro-animations, and reusable branded callouts
avoid: Do not assume downloaded Lottie assets inherit the runtime license

effects.label: Approved vector concept icon
effects.recipe: Use a locally owned or programmatically authored vector icon and bind its license/provenance before render.

tools.label: FFmpeg frei0r creative filters
responsibilities: Very short source-motivated glitch, texture, and stylized freeze-frame treatments
avoid: Do not obscure speech evidence, faces, diagrams, code, or interface labels

effects.label: Motivated digital-error glitch
effects.recipe: Use a sub-second RGB/glitch accent only when a digital error is literally part of the approved meaning.

effects.label: Stylized evidence freeze-frame
effects.recipe: Freeze the source-backed payoff frame, apply one restrained texture treatment, then return without a black flash.

tools.label: Depth Anything V2 Small Core ML
tools.engine: Local Apple Core ML Depth Anything V2 Small
tools.license: Apache-2.0 for the Small model only
responsibilities: Short 2.5D parallax and depth-aware text/particle layering
avoid: Do not use Base, Large, or Giant non-commercial weights
Do not process an entire programme for one short depth accent

effects.label: Short 2.5D depth parallax
effects.recipe: Generate depth locally for a short approved interval and move foreground/background subtly enough to avoid cardboard tearing.

tools.label: Three.js spatial scene
responsibilities: 3D typography, spatial system maps, glass panels, and camera fly-throughs
avoid: Do not use 3D when a flat diagram explains the same meaning more clearly

effects.label: Spatial system explainer
effects.recipe: Build one labelled spatial relationship, use slow camera easing, and finish on a readable flat-enough overview.

tools.label: G'MIC creative image filters
tools.license: CeCILL family; exact linked build must be recorded
responsibilities: Short comic, ink, engraving, blueprint, and texture treatments for freeze frames
avoid: Do not apply broad stylization to skin, diagrams, or a complete programme

effects.label: Graphic-style freeze-frame
effects.recipe: Apply one audited G'MIC recipe to a source-backed freeze frame and compare before/after skin and text detail.

tools.label: Curated FFmpeg xfade easing
tools.engine: Stock FFmpeg expressions with audited easing recipes
tools.license: MIT recipes + local FFmpeg build license
responsibilities: Meaning-motivated dissolve or geometry transition after a separately verified renderer exists
avoid: Never label a hard concat as xfade
Never use before picture/audio boundary behavior is release-tested

effects.label: Boundary-tested semantic xfade
effects.recipe: Use only a curated stock-FFmpeg expression in the separately boundary-tested renderer; verify picture and audio around the edit.

tools.label: Audited gl-transitions subset
tools.license: MIT collection; each selected shader header must be audited and recorded
responsibilities: Short displacement, luma, film-burn, or geometry transitions after renderer boundary verification
avoid: Do not load the whole shader collection without per-file license review
Do not use shader motion as a substitute for a semantic bridge

effects.label: Audited motivated shader transition
effects.recipe: Use one locally pinned and license-audited shader only in the separately boundary-tested renderer; inspect flashes and exact cut frames.

tools.label: SPRUT deterministic SFX
responsibilities: Restrained deterministic hit, whoosh, and riser accents
avoid: Do not mask speech or add an accent to every visual change

effects.label: Restrained payoff hit
effects.recipe: Render preset semantic_hit with generate_creative_sfx.py, align it to one approved landing, and verify the preview mix below speech.

effects.label: Soft label/icon pop
effects.recipe: Render preset soft_pop for one visible label, icon, or process-step activation; never repeat it for a rapid sequence.

effects.label: Meaningful UI/node tick
effects.recipe: Render preset ui_tick only when a visible control, cursor, or diagram node reaches an approved target.

effects.label: Technical state-change reveal
effects.recipe: Render preset digital_reveal for one technical text/data/state reveal; do not use it for organic or emotional footage.

effects.label: Motivated transition whoosh
effects.recipe: Render preset transition_whoosh only when an approved chapter bridge or directional wipe already supplies visible motion.

effects.label: Restrained pre-payoff reverse swell
effects.recipe: Render preset reverse_swell so its end lands on a real approved reveal; reject it when speech has no room for the lead-in.

effects.label: Exceptional high-stakes sub drop
effects.recipe: Render preset sub_drop only for an exceptional source-backed correction or consequence; allow at most one in a short.

effects.label: Meaning-driven audio glitch
effects.recipe: Render preset glitch_accent only when the approved meaning literally concerns error, failure, corruption, or a broken state.

effects.label: Hand-drawn annotation stroke
effects.recipe: Render preset marker_stroke exactly with a visible rough underline, circle, or arrow; never play it without drawing motion.

tools.label: ZzFX micro-SFX
responsibilities: Tiny deterministic UI ticks, digital pops, and vector-icon accents
avoid: Do not stack UI sounds under dense speech or replace the restrained SPRUT dialogue-first mix

effects.label: Tiny digital UI accent
effects.recipe: Synthesize one short local click or pop, align it to a visible UI/vector state change, and keep it clearly below speech.

tools.label: librosa beat/onset map
responsibilities: Align already justified cuts or accents to measured music onsets
avoid: Do not let the beat override speech, meaning, or complete explanations

effects.label: Measured beat-synced accent
effects.recipe: Snap an already justified landing to the nearest measured onset within a small tolerance; never move semantic timing to chase a beat.

tools.label: Apple Vision local person matte
responsibilities: Short presenter foreground layers and local face/person analysis for approved effects
avoid: Do not process a whole programme for a short masked effect
Do not infer that a matte authorizes circular presenter geometry
